messages:
julia_pm: Heads-up 1 ACME pilot asked for tenant-scoped SSO in MVP. They said if it's not in MVP, they'll push the pilot quarter. High commercial impact.

mike_eng: What's the rough lift?

julia_pm: Infra says ~3 sprints for end-to-end (auth flows, provisioning, QA). Could be trimmed if we limit to OIDC + manual provisioning and postpone admin UI.

anne_product: That reduces velocity risk but still a customer-driven add. Need a framework: revenue impact vs. schedule risk.

sam_sales: Commercial: ACME equates to a six-figure ARR pilot. Keeping pilot timeline likely preserves momentum. They already integrated our API for other features.

luis_design: We can ship a minimal runbook + hidden installer screens for MVP; full admin UX in v1.

mike_eng: Technically feasible: OIDC-only + manual tenant onboarding. Removes admin UI work; still requires secrets/KMS review and audit logs.

anne_product: Two options: A) MVP: OIDC + manual onboarding (no admin UI) 1 meets launch SLOs if sec signoff and infra ready. B) Defer SSO to v1 and keep milestone untouched but lose ACME pilot. Which preserves launch SLOs?

julia_pm: Launch SLOs = feature-complete + e2e tests + docs. Option A can meet SLOs if infra team drops UI and security clears manual flow. Option B definitely meets.

mike_eng: Capacity: dropping UI frees ~20% dev time. Option A estimate: 2 sprints (infra + QA). Option B: 0.5 sprints for docs only.

sam_sales: I can ask ACME if they'll accept manual onboarding for pilot. Likely yes if we provide runbook + support.

anne_product: Decision checklist: 1) commercial sign-off (sam) 2) engineering commit (mike) 3) security/governance (julie?) 4) launch docs (luis) 5) risk heatmap. If all green => choose A.

release-bot: milestone update: "MVP-ship" scheduled 1811116000, current status: at-risk for SSO scope.

julia_pm: Sam 1 ping ACME for explicit acceptance of manual provisioning by EOD. Mike 1 confirm infra lead capacity if we go A?

mike_eng: Will check with infra lead. Tentative yes; need to deprioritize caching perf. Will confirm by EOD 1811112400.

sam_sales: ACME replied: "manual onboarding acceptable for pilot as long as we have a runbook + handoff support." :thumbsup:

anne_product: Commercial sign-off 1. Engineering pending. Security: @security-team note: manual provisioning needs audit logging and rollback plan.

julia_pm: If engineering confirms next steps: 1) update scope doc to mark SSO as 'OIDC + manual onboarding' for MVP 2) update release plan & risk register 3) ship runbook for ACME 4) add UI to v1 backlog.

mike_eng: Confirmed. We can shift caching perf out and deliver A. Commit: 2 sprints for infra + QA, will not move MVP date.

luis_design: I'll draft runbook + minimal onboarding screens (hidden during MVP) and handoff notes.

anne_product: Documenting trade: accepted scope concession (SSO admin UI -> v1) to preserve commercial pilot. Keeping thread as record.

julia_pm: Closing: MVP scope updated: OIDC with manual tenant onboarding for pilots. v1 to include admin UI and automated provisioning. Thanks team. :tada:
